name: Data.depth_indicator_jet
summary: t is a power of g times the depth losses times a vacuum value. For a modulus (ϖ̄) and a prime p, a tight frame turns a product of monomials into the jet of a finite datum; the products Φ_α of translated ℘'-series and theta series carry exponents (IsCarriedBy), and a large split of the exponent a (HasLargeSplit, by the Katz bound when p splits in K and by Frobenius packings otherwise) gives a coefficient of the required size; a pigeonhole over the finitely many translates picks x₀.

steps.claim: Let V = Hom(I_1, I_12) over the field of D (the hom space of the standard spaces of ranks 1 and 12).
steps.lean: let V := (stdSpace D.E Unit).hom (stdSpace _ (Fin 12))

steps.claim: g = D.gProd ≠ 0, and the integral vacuum of V has a nonzero value y (exists_intVacuum_ne_zero; t0).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨g0, y, t0⟩ := NeZero.ne D.gProd, exists_intVacuum_ne_zero (V := V)

steps.claim: Let Q = g^{2·12f}·∏_σ depthLossInt(m(σ)) (a positive integer; depthLossInt(l) is the square of ∏_{i=1}^{c}(l' + i) with c = ⌈60b/k⌉ and l' = max(l − c, 0)).
steps.lean: let Q := D.gProd ^ (2 * (D.f * 12)) * ∏ σ, D.depthLossInt (m σ)

steps.claim: Q ≠ 0 (positivity of the factors).
steps.lean: have Q0 : Q ≠ 0 := by unfold Q depthLossInt; positivity

steps.claim: Take t = Q·(the vacuum value); t ≠ 0, and for every σ: |σ(t)| ≤ exp(fmb/k), from |σ| = |σ'| for some σ' ∈ Gal(ℂ/K) (exists_algEquiv_norm_eq), the bound of the integral vacuum (norm_intVacuum_le, with the constant P.c), the bound of the ascending factorials in depthLossInt (ascFactorial_le_pow_add, m(σ) ≤ w(σ) + x^42, nominalWeight_add_le) and the scale inequalities (le_of_hasLogBound). It remains to treat a modulus 𝔪 (hS: its ideal is (ϖ̄)) and a prime p (o).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨Q * _, by positivity, fun σ ↦ by
    grw [(P.exists_algEquiv_norm_eq σ).choose_spec, map_mul, norm_mul, norm_intVacuum_le,
      ← exp_nat_mul, ((le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)).trans (add_assoc ..).ge : _ ≤ P.c)]
    simp [Q, depthLossInt]; grw [ascFactorial_le_pow_add, tsub_le_self, le_floor (hm _).2,
      nominalWeight_add_le, floor_le_ceil, le_exp_log (_ ^ _ * _), ← exp_add]
    simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound, fun 𝔪 hS p o _ ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: Write m as a finitely supported function a on pairs (σ, ()): a(σ, ()) = m(σ).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a : _ × _ →₀ _, (a ⟨·, ()⟩) = m := ⟨Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.2 (m ·.1), rfl⟩

steps.claim: 0 < p and 1 < p; and a tight frame for the prime p of length J with vectors w_i and multiplicities c_i ≥ 3·|a| (exists_isTightFrame with R = 3·deg a, admissible because 3·deg a is below the bound by m(σ) ≤ w(σ) + x^42 and the scale inequalities), with some index i at which the frame vectors have unit size (h).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨q, hp1, J, _, w, c, hw, hc, i, h⟩ := o.1.pos, o.1.one_lt, @exists_isTightFrame P D.s p _ _
    D.gProd (a.degree * 3)
    (by rify [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]; grw [(hm _).2, nominalWeight_add_le]; simpa using
    D.le_of_hasLogBound)

steps.claim: Let S = P.periodFactor (the period s₁).
steps.lean: set S := P.periodFactor _

steps.claim: For each frame index i let μ_i be the linear form (x, ()) ↦ ι_p(S·conj(Φ_x(w_i))) (Φ_x the CM-type embedding at the place x).
steps.lean: let μ i := fun (x, ()) ↦ ιₚ (S * conj (Φ x (w i)))

steps.claim: Let Θ = ∏_i θ_ι(μ_i)^{c_i}, the product of the p-adic Taylor series of the theta function of the CM curve (taylorVia ι_p) substituted at the linear series μ_i, raised to the multiplicities.
steps.lean: let Θ := ∏ i, (taylorVia ιₚ P.cmCurve.θ).subst (linearSeries (μ i)) ^ c i

steps.claim: For every exponent α choose exponents e(α) (|e(α)| ≤ |α|) such that the coefficient at α of any product of the generators with Θ is at most that of ∏_i ℘'_i^{e(α)_i}·Θ (exists_monomial_max_norm_coeff in the ring multiPhiRing μ).
steps.lean: choose e he hN' using exists_monomial_max_norm_coeff (P.cmCurve.multiPhiRing μ) rfl Θ

steps.claim: Let Φ_α = (∏_i (Taylor series of the translated ℘'-derivative at μ_i)^{e(α)_i})·Θ.
steps.lean:
let Φ α :=
    (∏ i, (taylorVia ιₚ P.cmCurve.translatedWpDeriv).subst (linearSeries (μ i)) ^ e α i) * Θ

steps.claim: Let N(α) = |coeff_α(Φ_α)|, the norm of the α-th coefficient of Φ_α.
steps.lean: let N α := ‖coeff α (Φ α)‖₊

steps.claim: For every series H of the ring and every proof h of membership, H·Θ is carried by one copy of N (IsCarriedBy N 1: every coefficient of H·Θ is at most the N of its exponent), by the choice of e (hN').
steps.lean: have hΘ H h : IsCarriedBy N 1 (H * Θ) := (⟨![·], by simpa using! hN' _ _ h⟩)

steps.claim: Θ⁻¹ is carried by five copies of N (IsCarriedBy N 5 Θ⁻¹), proved in steps 15.1–15.6.
steps.lean:
have r : IsCarriedBy N 5 Θ⁻¹
  obtain ⟨⟨_, _, H⟩, j, hj⟩ := P.cmCurve.exists_log_theta, isClosed_property denseRange_natCast
    (isCompact_range (f := (∑ b, · b ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)).isClosed (·.sum_four_squares.elim
    fun a ⟨b, c, d, e⟩ ↦ ⟨![(a : ℤ_[p]), b, c, d], by simp [← e]⟩) (-1 + -1)
  have r b {k H} (h : IsCarriedBy N k H) := h.mul (H' := Θ.rescale fun _ ↦ (j b).1 • 1)
    (hΘ 1 (by simp) · |>.mono (by simp; grw [norm_le_one]; simp))
  have ⟨u, v, k⟩ := P.cmCurve.isSeriesGenerator_translatedWpDeriv.exists_mul_eq_one (SetLike.coe_mem
    (∏ b, ⟨_, (H.2.2.2.2.2 ((j b).1 • 1, (j
    b).1 ^ 2 • 1) (denseRange_natCast.induction_on (j b) (isClosed_closure.preimage (by fun_prop))
    (subset_closure ⟨·, by simp [sq, Algebra.smul_def]⟩))).2.1⟩)) (by simp [*])
  convert r 3 (r 2
    (r 1 (r 0 (hΘ _ (SetLike.coe_mem (∏ i, ⟨_, subst_mem_multiPhiRing _ v i⟩ ^ c i))))))
  refine .mp ?_ congr(∏ i, PowerSeries.substAlgHom (a := linearSeries (μ i)) (by simp) $k ^ c i)
  simp [*, Θ, MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one, expSubst_add, rescale_subst, add_smul,
    ← sum_smul, mul_pow, ← expSubst_sum, by simpa using congr(($hj).1)]; ring

steps.claim: The p-adic logarithm of theta: θ = exp(−L) with L = O(z²) (exists_log_theta, with H its properties); and four p-adic integers j_b with Σ_b j_b² = −2 (every natural number is a sum of four squares, natural numbers are dense in ℤ_p and the set of sums of four squares of p-adic integers is closed: isClosed_property).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨_, _, H⟩, j, hj⟩ := P.cmCurve.exists_log_theta, isClosed_property denseRange_natCast
    (isCompact_range (f := (∑ b, · b ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)).isClosed (·.sum_four_squares.elim
    fun a ⟨b, c, d, e⟩ ↦ ⟨![(a : ℤ_[p]), b, c, d], by simp [← e]⟩) (-1 + -1)

steps.claim: Multiplying a series carried by k copies of N by Θ rescaled by j_b gives one carried by k + 1 copies (IsCarriedBy.mul with step 14 and |j_b| ≤ 1).
steps.lean:
have r b {k H} (h : IsCarriedBy N k H) := h.mul (H' := Θ.rescale fun _ ↦ (j b).1 • 1)
    (hΘ 1 (by simp) · |>.mono (by simp; grw [norm_le_one]; simp))

steps.claim: The product over b of the translated ℘'-series at (j_b, j_b²) is a unit of the series ring generated by the translated ℘'-derivative (isSeriesGenerator_translatedWpDeriv.exists_mul_eq_one): there are u, v with v·(product) = 1 (k).
steps.lean:
have ⟨u, v, k⟩ := P.cmCurve.isSeriesGenerator_translatedWpDeriv.exists_mul_eq_one (SetLike.coe_mem
    (∏ b, ⟨_, (H.2.2.2.2.2 ((j b).1 • 1, (j
    b).1 ^ 2 • 1) (denseRange_natCast.induction_on (j b) (isClosed_closure.preimage (by fun_prop))
    (subset_closure ⟨·, by simp [sq, Algebra.smul_def]⟩))).2.1⟩)) (by simp [*])

steps.claim: Hence Θ⁻¹ equals (v-substituted series)·Θ·(Θ rescaled by j_0, …, j_3), carried by 1 + 4 = 5 copies (steps 14 and 15.2 four times), once the identity of series below is shown.
steps.lean:
convert r 3 (r 2
    (r 1 (r 0 (hΘ _ (SetLike.coe_mem (∏ i, ⟨_, subst_mem_multiPhiRing _ v i⟩ ^ c i))))))

steps.claim: Substitute the linear series μ_i into the identity k and take the product over i with exponents c_i.
steps.lean: refine .mp ?_ congr(∏ i, PowerSeries.substAlgHom (a := linearSeries (μ i)) (by simp) $k ^ c i)

steps.claim: The resulting identity is Θ⁻¹ = … : the exponential of the sum of the substituted logarithms with Σ_b j_b² = −2 (hj) cancels (expSubst_add, rescale_subst), verified by simp and ring.
steps.lean:
simp [*, Θ, MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one, expSubst_add, rescale_subst, add_smul,
    ← sum_smul, mul_pow, ← expSubst_sum, by simpa using congr(($hj).1)]; ring

steps.claim: Every series H of the ring times Θ·Θ⁻¹ is carried by 1 + 5 = 6 copies: h6 (steps 14, 15).
steps.lean: have h6 := by simpa [mul_assoc, Θ] using (hΘ · · |>.mul r)

steps.claim: Katz's divisibility limit for the CM curve: for each n a series f_n of the φ-ring with a coefficient of controlled valuation (katz_divisibility_limit: k, l).
steps.lean: choose f k l using katz_divisibility_limit P.cmCurve

steps.claim: For every exponent a: HasLargeSplit N 12 a with the bound given by the Katz divisibility of the substituted f (hC), from h6 and the frame index i of step 7 (h).

    ← rpow_sum_of_pos] using ((h6 _ (subst_mem_multiPhiRing _ (k _) i) a).mono
    (by simp [μ, -map_mul, h]; grw [← norm_mul, ← l]) :)

steps.claim: The exponent a has a large split into 12 parts: HasLargeSplit N 12 a (p^{−F(p) − Σ_x v_p(depthLossInt(a x)) + Σ_x v_p((a x)!)}) — a = Σ_b α_b with ∏_b N(α_b) at least that bound (α, hα, H).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨α, hα, H⟩ : HasLargeSplit N 12 a (p ^ (-D.forcedPart p - ∑ x,
    ↑(padicValNat p (D.depthLossInt (a x))) + ∑ x, ↑(padicValNat p (a x)!)))
  · by_cases l : chiK P.d p = 1
    · convert ((hC a).mul (hC 0)).mono _ <;> simp [forcedPart, localAsk, nonsplitWeight, *,
        Finset.sum_nonneg]
    have k i := (coprime_primes o.1 (D.g_prime i)).2 (l <|
      chiK_eq_one_of_modEq_one <| · ▸ D.g_modEq_one _)
    obtain ⟨s1, i, y, A, h4⟩ := (@norm_iota_periodFactor_eq_one P D.s p _ · (l ∘ chiK_eq_one_of_dvd
      _ o.1)), D.exists_isFrobPacking hm o.1 l
    obtain ⟨b, e, τ, t, u, z, G⟩ := exists_hasLargeSplit_of_pairs l A (by simpa using hΘ 1)
      (by simp [Θ]) r ⟨_, _, _, _, 1, S, 0, hw.repeat_vectors, by
      simpa [Θ, μ, S, *, prod_prod_type, Fintype.prod_sigma] using .mul_right (k 0) (k 1)⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨h, rfl, h4⟩ | h4⟩ := exists_add_of_le e, h4
    obtain ⟨F, H⟩ : ∃ F : P.cmCurve.multiPhiRing μ,
      IsLowestTerm 1 F a (ιₚ (conj S * S * D.gProd) ^ a.degree) := a.toMultiset_toFinsupp ▸
      a.toMultiset.induction_on ⟨1, by simp [IsLowestTerm]⟩ fun (x, _) _ ⟨F, v⟩ ↦ by
      simp_rw [← Multiset.singleton_add, map_add, pow_add]
      refine ⟨⟨_, ∑ i, .C (c i * ⟨_, norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one (ι :=
        ⟨ιₚ.comp conj⟩) (hw.1 i) x⟩) * .X i, RingHom.comp_apply ..⟩ * F, .mul (fun d hd ↦ ?_) v⟩
      simp [Finsupp.weight_apply, le_succ_iff, Finsupp.sum_eq_one_iff, map_mul, -map_natCast,
        ↓substAlgHom_X, coeff_monomial, mul_assoc, @eq_comm _ d] at hd ⊢
      obtain rfl | ⟨y, _, ⟨⟩⟩ := hd.imp_left d.degree_eq_zero_iff.1 <;> simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
      simpa [μ, mul_sum, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (ιₚ S), apply_ite ιₚ, cast_comm,
        apply_ite factorial, Finsupp.single_left_inj] using congr(ιₚ (conj S * S * $(hw.2 _ y)))
    apply (G.mul (h6 _ F.2 _)).mono
    simp [H a, gProd, (k _).norm_natCast_eq_one, show ‖ιₚ (conj _)‖ = 1 from s1 ⟨.comp ..⟩, *, S,
      nonsplitWeight, sq,
      ← sum_mul, sum_prod_type, field, mul_self_sub_one, ← cast_sum] at h4 ⊢; linarith
    apply (G.mul (hC a)).mono
    have v {x n} (h : n ≤ (b + a) x) := @padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc p _ n (D.b₂ * 2) (by
      grw [h, pow_mul, ← Nat.lt_pow_self hp1, ← @cast_le ℝ, (hm _).2]
      use D.le_of_hasLogBound)
    grw [(v le_rfl).2, ← (v le_add_self).1, ← (v (t _)).1] <;> simp [← rpow_add, ← cast_sum, ← z,
      hp1, q, ← mul_sum, div_eq_inv_mul, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, sum_prod_type] at h4 ⊢ <;> linarith
